_about: The public registry of this harness's per-machine secrets (DND-845). Names, paths and procedures only: NEVER a value. Schema and rules: ai/contracts/athena-machine-secrets.md -> The registry. Work-domain secrets are declared in the private overlay's overlay/secrets.json instead. An entry absent on a machine is listed by ai/bin/check-machine-secrets as 'not provisioned here', never failed.

secrets.name: claude-code-oauth
secrets.restart: none: Claude Code reads and refreshes it itself

secrets.name: github-app-key
consumers: ai/bin/gh-athena (signs the App JWT per call)
secrets.restart: none: read on every gh-athena call
secrets.rotate: GitHub App settings -> Private keys: generate a new key, then delete the old one (owner)

secrets.name: github-app-install-token
consumers: ai/bin/gh-athena (cached installation token, GH_TOKEN in the gh child only)
secrets.restart: none: gh-athena re-mints it when it expires
secrets.rotate: rm the file; the next gh-athena call mints a new one from github-app-key

secrets.name: gitlab-bot-token
consumers: ai/bin/glab-athena (GITLAB_TOKEN in the glab child only)
secrets.restart: none: read on every glab-athena call
secrets.rotate: GitLab bot user -> Access tokens: create a new token, then revoke the old one (owner)

secrets.name: slack-bot-token
secrets.rotate: Slack app config -> OAuth & Permissions: rotate or reinstall (owner)

secrets.name: notion-personal-token
consumers: notion-personal MCP server via ai/bin/notion-athena-mcp (NOTION_ATHENA_TOKEN_FILE; NOTION_TOKEN in the MCP child only)
secrets.restart: reconnect the notion-personal MCP server (/mcp), or restart the session
secrets.rotate: Notion -> integration settings: refresh the secret (owner)

secrets.name: notion-work-token
consumers: notion-work MCP server via ai/bin/notion-athena-mcp (its default token file; NOTION_TOKEN in the MCP child only)
secrets.restart: reconnect the notion-work MCP server (/mcp), or restart the session
secrets.rotate: Notion -> integration settings: refresh the secret; the path is a symlink, so overwrite its target (owner)

secrets.name: inbox-machine-token
secrets.restart: stop the inbox client (the */5 cron entry relaunches it), then reconnect the athena MCP server (/mcp)
secrets.rotate: reissue this machine's token on the athena server (per machine; never copy one between machines)

secrets.name: aws-cli
consumers: terraform, via eval of aws configure export-credentials inside one Bash call

secrets.name: aws-static-key
secrets.rotate: IAM: create a new access key, write it here, then delete the old key (owner); not a re-run of aws login

secrets.name: op-cli-config
consumers: the owner's 1Password CLI (no harness tool uses it)

secrets.name: gh-cli-hosts
secrets.rotate: gh auth login / gh auth refresh (owner)

secrets.name: gcloud-credentials
secrets.rotate: gcloud auth login / gcloud auth application-default login (owner)

secrets.name: GEN_SAAS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
consumers: the gen_saas dev server: ai/bin/with-secret GEN_SAAS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -- mix phx.server, or GEN_SAAS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_FILE once gen_saas dev config reads it
secrets.rotate: Anthropic console: create a new key, write it here, then revoke the old one (owner)

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
consumers: gen_saas local dev email (config/runtime.exs outside prod): ai/bin/with-secret RESEND_API_KEY -- mix phx.server
secrets.rotate: resend.com dashboard, API Keys: create a new key, write it here, then revoke the old one (owner)
